language.title: Language
language.body: Choose the language for the app. Your saved records will not change.

actions.signOutHint: Signs out and returns to the sign-in screen.
actions.deleteJournalsHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every journal entry.
actions.deleteNotesHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every note.
actions.deleteAuditHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every audit response.
actions.deleteBfiHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting saved Big Five results.
actions.deleteEcrHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting saved Attachment results.
actions.deleteMbtiHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting saved MBTI reference results.
actions.deleteWikiHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every wiki page.
actions.deleteUningestedHint: Asks you to confirm before deleting captures not yet organized into wiki pages.
actions.resetUsageHint: Asks you to confirm before resetting daily usage.
actions.fullWipeInputLabel: Delete all data. Type {{phrase}} to enable the delete button.
actions.fullWipeHint: Requires typed DELETE confirmation before wiping records, sources, wiki pages, and usage.

dataWizard.body: Choose which data to delete. You can delete by type or delete all content.
dataWizard.selectedHint: This data type is selected. Choose what to delete below.

records.label: Records
records.hint: Shows deletion actions for journals, notes, and audit responses.
records.body: Clear one private record type while keeping the rest of your graph and wiki intact.

assessments.label: Assessments
assessments.hint: Shows deletion actions for saved assessment results.
assessments.body: Remove saved reference results without touching journals, captures, or wiki pages.

library.label: Wiki and captures
library.hint: Shows options for deleting wiki pages, captures not yet organized, and usage history.
library.body: Delete wiki pages and captures while keeping private records and shared graph references.

full.label: Delete all content
full.hint: Shows the typed confirmation for deleting all records, sources, wiki pages, and usage.
full.body: Deleting all content cannot be undone. Export what you need, then type DELETE to confirm.
full.retained: This clears private 2nd-B content in this account. Account details, consent history, and service accountability records stay.

clearRecordsError: Could not delete these records. Try again shortly.
clearResultsError: Could not delete these results. Try again shortly.
clearWikiError: Could not delete your wiki pages. Try again shortly.
clearCapturesError: Could not delete these captures. Try again shortly.
resetUsageError: Could not reset usage. Try again shortly.
wipeRemainBody: Some data may remain. Try again shortly to delete what is left.
deletionUndo: Deletion cannot be undone. Export anything you need first.
subtitleFull: Adjust your app settings. Deletion cannot be undone, so export anything you need first.
autoTaggingDesc: Sort into stars and tags on capture
suggestionAlertsDesc: Notify me when something new is found in my records
onDeviceFirstDesc: Analyze raw text only on device
callRecordingDesc: Turn call notes into text and let SecondB organize them by star.
googleCalendarDesc: Review daily routines and relationships through your events
appleHealthDesc: Sleep and activity for the health star
manageIntegrationsDesc: Import from calendars, health apps, Notion, and more
importDataDesc: Paste or pick an exported file to turn it into records
workingPaused: Working on it. Other actions and sign-out are paused until this finishes.
resetCoachmarksDesc: Replay the home guide from the start
partialByKindDesc: Delete one kind only. Other kinds and your wiki stay.
delBigFiveDesc: Delete every saved BFI-44 result. Include older TIPI records if present.
delMbtiDesc: Delete every saved MBTI reference result.
delAllWikiDesc: Deletes all wiki pages and links between them. Inbox sources stay.
delUningestedDesc: Only deletes captures that have not been organized into wiki pages.
resetDailyDesc: Clears all usage history, including today.
dangerFullWipeDesc: Deletes records, sources, wiki pages, and SecondB usage together. Your account stays, but you start again from zero.
cannotUndoExport: This cannot be undone. Export anything you need first.
finalCheck: Deleted data cannot be restored. Make sure you have exported anything you need.
signOutError: Could not sign out. Try again shortly.
wipeComplete: Full wipe complete: records {{r}} · sources {{s}} · wiki {{w}} · usage {{u}}

subscription.title: Manage subscription
subscription.judgeComp: This judge account can use paid features for free.
subscription.freeBody: You are on the free plan, so there is no active paid subscription.
subscription.loadFailed: Could not load your subscription details.
subscription.supportLine: Email {{email}} for help. We reply within 2 business days.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.body: Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel. Cancelling stops the next charge and keeps your paid features until the period you already paid for ends.
cancel.unavailable: This subscription cannot be cancelled from the app. If you bought it through a store, cancel it in that store's subscription settings.
cancel.confirmAtRenewal: Your subscription will not renew after {{date}}. You can use paid features until then.
cancel.confirmImmediate: You will lose access to paid features immediately. The remaining time is not refunded automatically.
cancel.switchToRenewal: Cancel at the next renewal instead
cancel.periodEnd: the end of the paid period
cancel.alreadyScheduled: Auto-renewal is already off for this subscription. Nothing more will be charged, and paid features stay open until the paid period ends.
cancel.refundOfferNote: You are inside the refund window. Requesting it together ends paid access right away.

refund.title: Refund
refund.confirmBody: The request goes to Paddle, the seller of record. If Paddle approves it, the full amount returns to your original payment method. This does not cancel the subscription on its own, so cancel it too if you want the billing to stop.

reason.eligible: You can request a full refund right now.
reason.alreadyRequested: A refund request for this payment is already on file.
reason.usedBeyondFree: Your usage since payment exceeds the free plan limit for the same period. You cannot get a refund directly in the app.
reason.windowPassed: More than {{total}} days have passed since payment. You cannot get a refund directly in the app.
reason.noPayment: There is no payment on record to refund.
reason.unknown: We could not check whether you can get a refund.

refund.usage: Connections used: {{used}} (free plan limit for the same period: {{allowance}})
refund.currentPolicyNote: Refundable within 7 days of payment, as long as your usage has stayed within what the free plan covers.

notice.cancelledAtRenewal: Cancellation is scheduled for the next renewal date.
notice.refundRequested: Your refund request was sent to Paddle. The decision will be emailed to the address used for your payment receipt. Cancel your subscription separately to stop future charges.
notice.alreadyRequested: This request has already been received. It was not sent again.
notice.refundRejected: You cannot get a refund for this payment directly in the app.
notice.contactSupport: This cannot be handled in the app right now. Please contact support.
notice.notSubscribed: There is no active paid subscription to cancel.
notice.dryRun: Test mode is on, so no request was sent to Paddle. Contact support to submit a real request.
notice.cancelledAndRefundRequested: Your subscription was cancelled and a refund was requested. The payment provider will review the request before deciding whether to issue a refund.
notice.cancelledRefundNotAccepted: Your subscription was cancelled, but the refund request was not accepted. Contact support if this was unexpected.

subscription.cancelScheduledOn: Auto-renewal is off. Paid features stay open until {{date}}.
subscription.cancelScheduled: Auto-renewal is off. Paid features stay open until the paid period ends.
